# Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)

**Project:** ai-governance-mcp
**Version:** 2.1.0
**Python:** >=3.10
**License:** Apache-2.0 (code), CC-BY-NC-ND-4.0 (framework content)
**Build System:** hatchling
**Maintenance:** generated by `scripts/gen_sbom.py` from `pyproject.toml` (source of truth for versions/constraints) + curated license/purpose data. Run `python scripts/gen_sbom.py --check` to catch drift. Do not hand-edit.

## Core Dependencies

| Package | Version | License | Purpose |
|---------|---------|---------|---------|
| mcp | 1.28.1 | MIT | MCP Python SDK (`mcp.server.Server`) |
| pydantic | 2.11.9 | MIT | Data validation and schemas |
| pydantic-settings | 2.11.0 | MIT | Settings management |
| sentence-transformers | 5.2.0 | Apache 2.0 | Embedding generation and cross-encoder reranking |
| rank-bm25 | 0.2.2 | Apache 2.0 | BM25 keyword search |
| numpy | 1.26.4 | BSD-3-Clause | Vector operations |
| requests | >=2.33.0 | Apache 2.0 | HTTP client (required by sentence-transformers) |
| pyyaml | >=6.0 | MIT | YAML frontmatter parsing for reference library entries |

| tree-sitter-language-pack | >=0.7.0,<1.0 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | AST-based code parsing (160+ languages, 6 priority). Pulls tree-sitter as transitive dep. |

| pdfplumber | >=0.10.0 | MIT | PDF extraction (fallback) |

## Build Platform

- **Distribution:** pip install (editable or wheel)
- **PyTorch:** CPU-only (no CUDA)

## Security Notes

- **Known-vulnerability status is not asserted statically here — it drifts.** Source of truth: GitHub Dependabot alerts (repo Security tab) + `pip-audit` on demand. As of 2026-07-16, three high-severity `mcp` SDK transport advisories (CVE-2026-52869 / -52870 / -59950) are remediated by the `mcp>=1.28.1` pin; the vulnerable transports (HTTP/WebSocket) are not exercised — this server runs stdio-only.
- No hardcoded secrets or credentials in source
- All user input validated (query length limits, parameter bounds)
- Pickle deserialization disabled (`allow_pickle=False`)
